description: Defines utility functions and a class for file handling in tests, including creating temporary files, retrieving test data directories, and managing random files with cleanup.

classes.name: ScopedRandomFile
classes.description: A utility class for creating and managing temporary random files, with automatic cleanup.

methods.name: GetTempDir
methods.description: Returns the temporary directory path used by ScopedRandomFile.

methods.name: GetFileTestsDataDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where static test data for files is stored.

methods.name: GetFileTestsFilePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of file paths in the static test data directory.

methods.name: GetFileTestsDirectoryPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of directory paths in the static test data directory.

methods.name: GetTestFileExpectedContent
methods.description: Returns the expected content of a specified static test file.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile
methods.description: Class for creating a temporary file with random content, which is deleted when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile()
methods.description: Default constructor that creates a file of default length.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile(int length)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a file of specified length.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile(int length, Create create)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a file of specified length or just generates a filename based on the 'create' flag.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile(Create create)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a default-length file or just generates a filename based on the 'create' flag.

methods.name: filename()
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the object.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns the specified size of the file.

methods.name: ExpectPattern
methods.description: Checks if a buffer matches a specific pattern, used for testing.

methods.name: MakeRandomFilename
methods.description: Generates a random filename without creating a file.

methods.name: MakeRandomFile
methods.description: Creates a file with a random name and specified size.

methods.name: MakeRandomFilePath
methods.description: Generates a path for a random file without creating it.
